name: LinExponentialPotential
description: LinExponential Potential with only Cundall-and-Strack-like contact. The LinExponential potential formula is $F(u) = \frac{k*(x_e-x_0)}{x_e}(u/a-x_0)\exp\left(\frac{-(u/a)}{x_e-x_0}\right)$. Where $k$ is the slope at the origin, $x_0$ is the position where the potential cross $0$ and $x_e$ is the position of the extremum.

attributes.name: x0
attributes.description: Equilibrium distance. Potential force is 0 at $x_0$ (LinExponential)

attributes.name: xe
attributes.description: Extremum position. Position of local max/min of force. (LinExponential)

attributes.name: F0
attributes.description: Force at contact. Force when $F_0 = F(u=0)$ (LinExponential)

attributes.name: Fe
attributes.description: Extremum force. Value of force at extremum. (LinExponential)

methods.name: computeParametersFromF0
methods.description: Set parameters of the potential, with $k$ computed from $F_0$

methods.name: computeParametersFromF0Fe
methods.description: Set parameters of the potential, with $k$ and $x_0$ computed from $F_0$ and $F_e$

methods.name: potential
methods.description: Get potential value at any point.

methods.name: updateAttrs
methods.description: Update object attributes from given dictionary
